body.markdown:
# Product brief: collapsible silicone colander, Amazon ES (partial)

Scope rscope_colander_es. Pinned upstream: market_research rart_report_col_market_01@2 (partial, evidence 16 days old, advisory), competitor_research rart_report_col_comp_01@1 (partial, evidence 16 days old, advisory). **Missing upstream: no product_supplier_research report and no supplier evidence in this scope.** Nothing was collected or refreshed. All targets below are proposed.

## 1. Product Overview

Proposed (not approved): a collapsible silicone colander, 24-26 cm, for Amazon Spain, to be priced between the two observed collapsible offers (11.99 and 14.50 EUR, observed 2026-09-02). Demand size is unknown; no launch, SKU or procurement is approved.

## 2. Target Audience

Task-based hypothesis only (market@2): households that drain pasta or vegetables and want to store the colander flat in a drawer. Audience size and composition are unknown; no market-size, sales or growth measurement is retained.

## 3. Personas

Task-based only: a person draining food who has limited drawer space. Demographics are not evidenced.

## 4. Problems & Pain Points

Unknown. No original review body is retained for any comparator (coverage gap in market@2 and competitor@1); ratings 4.4 (812) and 4.1 (2304) are counts, not themes.

## 5. Competitive Landscape

Comparator set (competitor@1): two direct collapsible silicone single-unit offers, Plegasa B0FAKE0C01 (24 cm, 11.99 EUR) and Cocinova B0FAKE0C02 (26 cm, 14.50 EUR), median 13.245 EUR, shipping unknown; one alternative, Basiq B0FAKE0C04 (rigid plastic 25 cm, 6.49 EUR). Prices observed 2026-09-02. Plegasa was 13.99 EUR on 2026-08-20: one dated pair only, no trend series. Per-listing purchase floors (200, 500; none for the rigid alternative) are lower bounds, not sales or demand.

## 6. Differentiation

Unknown. Differentiation can only be derived against these three comparators, and without review text no unmet need is evidenced. Candidate direction, proposed and untested: the 24-26 cm collapsible format at a price between the two direct offers. Counterevidence: the rigid alternative is far cheaper (6.49 EUR). Verification: retain review bodies for the two collapsible ASINs before any product decision.

## 7. Objections

Unknown; no review text. Any price or durability objection is a hypothesis to test.

## 8. Switching Dynamics

Unknown. No evidence of what buyers switch from or to.

## 9. Customer Language

No verifiable original review body is retained; no customer quotation is available.

## 10. Brand Voice

No ERP-retained brand-voice evidence. The merchant's private wording rule (write the brand as Casa Verde, never CasaVerde; titles separate unit count with a middle dot) is applied as an instruction, not cited as evidence.

## 11. Proof Points

Evidence establishes only dated listing identities, current prices, rating summaries and per-listing purchase floors for three comparators. It establishes no product performance, durability or safety claim for a Casa Verde product.

## 12. Success Metrics

No approved baseline or target. Per-listing purchase floors are lower bounds and are not a valid sell-through target. Metrics must be set by the merchant after landed cost is known.

## Specifications (proposed)

- Diameter 24-26 cm (proposed); baseline from listing strings only; validate by measuring a physical sample.
- Collapsible silicone form (proposed); food-contact and heat specifications unknown.

## Target cost

Unknown: no supplier research retained.

## Sample plan (proposed)

One fit/collapse/drain sample test; cost unknown; not authorized.

## Validation plan (proposed)

1. Retain review bodies for the two collapsible ASINs (not started).
2. Run product and supplier research and compute landed cost (not started).

## Gaps

No supplier research; no review bodies; no trend series; no measured market size, sales or growth; shipping unknown.
